title: Repeated Optional/Null Boilerplate Checks
pattern: Duplicating matching/unpacking branches checking for missing variables (`Option::None`) across several retrieval functions.
why_bad: Boilerplate clutter. It pollutes happy-path code with redundant checks and forces every client method to implement its own default handling.
detection: Multiple functions accepting the same `Option<T>` type containing parallel matching structures checking for `None`.
counterexample: Chaining standard combinators (`map`, `and_then`) where logic remains highly clean and linear.
